This data mining contains preview images of the current PTS from September 28, 2024 for patch 55/56 "Gleaming Depths". Some items may be released in the mid-Season 18 patch, or as late as December. This is not apparent in the data. On display are Atom Shop items and Season 19 rewards. Lots of things with the theme: “Enclave”.
